experiments.description: Increasing write_value_dim to 256 will expand the effective memory capacity per write vector without violating the state_size constraint.

hypothesis.hypothesis: Increasing write_value_dim to 256 will expand the effective memory capacity per write vector without violating the state_size constraint.
hypothesis.rationale: The directions explicitly flag write_value_dim as the primary intended capacity knob and current biggest miss. Scaling it tests the throughput vs. capacity trade-off in the pool-1tps regime.
hypothesis.instruction: Set the `write_value_dim` parameter to `256` in the experiment config file.

experiments.description: Setting num_memory_vectors to 4 and switching write_mode to cross_attn will multiply write throughput per segment while maintaining parallel-prefill compatibility.

hypothesis.hypothesis: Setting num_memory_vectors to 4 and switching write_mode to cross_attn will multiply write throughput per segment while maintaining parallel-prefill compatibility.
hypothesis.rationale: With tokens_per_segment locked at 1, increasing M is the only viable path to scale write capacity. cross_attn is required to structurally support M>1 writes.
hypothesis.instruction: Update `num_memory_vectors` to `4` and change `write_mode` to `cross_attn` in the experiment config file.
